summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K disclosing a prospectus supplement dated October 13, 2026 that increases the maximum aggregate offering amount of American Depositary Shares sellable under its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co., LLC, originally dated February 3, 2025. Each ADS represents 10,000 ordinary shares, no par value. Up to $2,587,409 in Placement ADSs may be sold from time to time. No price per share, premium, or closing date is stated. Legal opinions from Goldfarb Gross Seligman and Haynes and Boone are attached. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for dilution and ATM selling pressure.
